Honestly, it’s the perfect setting for someone who dances with the devil.

On Wednesday’s episode of “The Daily Show,” host Josh Johnson pointed out one detail from Donald Trump Jr.’s wedding that looks like it’s straight out of a very popular horror movie — and you can’t unsee it.

Johnson set up his hilarious one-liner by playing a clip of Trump sharing a video of his nuptials to socialite Bettina Trump that took place in May on a small island in the Bahamas.

The clip, backed to an acoustic version of The Ronettes “Be My Baby,” features an overhead shot the church President Donald Trump’s eldest son got hitched in before revealing some interior shots of the guests inside. The video shows footage of Trump Jr.’s siblings, Ivanka and Tiffany Trump, sitting in pews before playing slow motion footage of the bride and the groom hugging at the altar under a gigantic cross.

“What a beautiful ceremony in the church from ‘Sinners,’” Johnson joked alongside an image from the Oscar-winning film that shows Sammie (Miles Caton) walking into his father’s church covered in blood. Above Sammie’s head — much like Don Jr. and his bride — is a giant cross. The exterior of the church from “Sinners” also resembles the exterior of the church in the Bahamas.

Donald Trump Jr.’s wedding has received widespread scrutiny after ProPublica reported earlier this week that it was bankrolled by Russian oligarch Umar Kremlev who has close ties to President Vladimir Putin.

In response to the fiasco, Bettina Trump posted a statement on Instagram clarifying: “Don and I got married privately on Friday, surrounded ONLY by our family.”

“The weekend that followed had actually been planned well in advance as a fun weekend with friends,” she continued. “It was never intended to be our wedding weekend. When our original wedding plans changed, we simply decided to get married before it and arrived at an already planned weekend as newlyweds.”

She went on to write that the couple’s “dear friend Umar very generously hosted two incredible nights of celebrations for us AFTER our wedding.”

Johnson also had a pretty funny response to Bettina Trump’s clarification.

“Yeah, that’s right, fake news,” Johnson said, channeling Bettina Trump. “They didn’t pay for my wedding, they paid for the much more expensive after party.”
